messages:
hana: Heads-up from usability testing this morning: when users toggle the sampling dropdown while dragging the scrubber, the p95 callout sometimes detaches and lands over controls. Repro: hold drag -> open sampling menu -> toggle option. Video: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/2212345678-detach.mp4

leo: I can repro on staging. Looks like we compute the callout X position before the new bucket widths are applied, so one frame it's at the old coord then jumps.

sophie: UX idea: keep the callout mounted in a fixed overlay layer (transform only) and animate bucket swaps via opacity. That should avoid reflow-driven jumps. Also maybe disable the sampling menu while an active drag is in progress?

ram: Prefer not to block interactions. Overlay + opacity is better. Quick attach: add aria-live updates for p95 so screen readers don't miss a value if the DOM node moves. Keep focus ring visible during transforms.

a11y-bot: For screen readers: announce full units ("one hundred twenty milliseconds") and prefix with "Chart percentiles:". Make the sampling option readable as "Sampling on, approximate results" and "Sampling off, exact results". Avoid parentheses.

hana: Microcopy tweak: change preset labels from "1h"/"6h" to "Last 1 hour"/"Last 6 hours" — testers found the short labels cryptic. Also the sampling help text should read: "Sampling approximates percentiles to reduce compute on long ranges. Turn off for exact numbers."

leo: Tech note: we'll implement overlay for the scrubber and callout, throttle tooltip reposition to 80ms, and keep bucket virtualization intact. For bucket swaps we'll crossfade old/new sets at 100ms to reduce perceived jank.

sophie: Also add a tiny scrub-step control next to the scrubber defaulting by range (1m for <2h, 5m for 2-24h, 1h otherwise). Keyboard users can change with arrow keys and shift+arrow accelerates. Announce step changes via aria-live.

ram: Accessibility: ensure ESC closes any open menu and returns focus to the opener. When a preset is selected announce "Time range: Last 1 hour". For the scrub-step control announce full-language labels like "one minute" not "1m".

a11y-bot: Automated checks: live region present, aria-labels verbose, focus flows valid. One recommendation: include a brief prefixed label in the live region like "Heatmap update:" before percentile values to provide context in busy pages.

hana: Good. Let's ship this as a small UX + a11y patch. Changelog line: "Heatmap: stabilize p95 callout & scrubber during sampling/preset changes; add scrub-step control; improve screen-reader announcements."

leo: I'll open a small PR and post a staging preview URL when ready. Thanks team. :shipit:
